exposure: interval from caesarean section to symptom emerging
Interval from caesarean section to symptom onset
Straight or retroflexed uterus vs. other uterus shapes
Interval from caesarean section to symptom emerging >3 months vs. <=3 months
Repeated caesarean section vs. single caesarean section
cohort: 123 patients with caesarean scar defect (CSD) and menstruation period >7 days due to postmenstrual bleeding
finding: Defect volume >600 mm(3), interval from caesarean section to symptom emerging >3 months, and straight or retroflexed uterus were protective factors against poor effect (menstruation period >10 days after surgery), while repeated caesarean section was a risk factor.
